description: Defines IPC message structures, classes, and templates for RPC communication within the Thunder namespace, including Frame, Input, Output, Init, and Setup classes, as well as message types AnnounceMessage and InvokeMessage.

classes.name: Frame
classes.description: Represents a data frame for IPC, providing serialization and deserialization methods.

classes.name: Input
classes.description: Encapsulates input message data, including validation, setting, and retrieving implementation, interface, and method IDs.

classes.name: Output
classes.description: Encapsulates output message data, including adding implementations and serialization.

classes.name: Init
classes.description: Represents initialization message with different types (ACQUIRE, OFFER, REVOKE, REQUEST), including setting and validation.

classes.name: Setup
classes.description: Represents setup message with configuration details like implementation, sequence number, paths, and categories.

methods.name: instance_cast
methods.description: Converts an incoming value to Core::instance_id, accommodating 32-bit and 64-bit systems.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the object data into a byte stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a byte stream into the object.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets message data fields such as implementation, interface, method IDs, or configuration parameters.

methods.name: Implementation
methods.description: Retrieves the implementation ID from the message.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the size of the message data.
